Item/Shop
  • Range attributes for guns have been added into the weapon tooltips.

Bug Fixes
  • Default resolution is different from the real resolution in the setting dialog when a player first executes the client.
  • Tooltip information on weapons is different from the info in the purchase dialog.
  • Tooltip comment appears overlapped with other information.
  • Player can't buy item when player has exact same amount of currency as the item price.

Bug Fixes


  • Match timer countdown while master client is loading the map.
  • Language for Brick palette tabs is not changed after changing language at the login screen.

Shooter Mode


  • Localization update: kills has been changed to K.O.

Miscellaneous


  • Localization update: many different texts have been adjusted, affecting the following languages - English, German, French, Turkish, Spanish, and Polish.

Weapon Names
Main/Medium (Previously Assault)
BR16 Assault Rifle ---> Cyclone 16
BK47 Assault Rifle ---> Thunder 47
BR4 Assault Rifle ---> Hurricane 4
BTG44 ---> Tornado 44
B2 ---> Lightning 2
B8A1 Carbine ---> Typhoon 8
B85A2 --->Cirrus 85

Main/Heavy (Previously MG)
BM1918 ---> Bronto 1000
BG42 ---> Saurus 42

Main/Light (Previously Submachine
BRZ Submachine Gun ---> Scorpion 5
BPSH41 Submachine Gun ---> Tarantula 41
BMK ---> Wasp 25
B1 ---> Mosquito 1
FAMAS ---> Locust 5
B36K ---> Spider 36
BK416 ---> Scarab 4.16
BZ96 Beryl ---> Hornet 96

Main/Long (Previously Sniper)
BSG69 Sniper Rifle ---> Adder 69
BMN91 ---> Python 91
BWM ---> Boa 20
BRG42 ---> Cobra 42
B82A1 ---> Viper 1
BNG90 ---> Mamba 90

Secondary (Previously Pistols)
BM9 ---> Condor 9
BC1900 ---> Blackhawk 1900
BA14 Revolver ---> Hawk 14
BWPP ---> Harrier 33
BD12 ---> Eagle 12
BG18 ---> Falcon 18
LP08 ---> Buzzard 08

Close (Previously Melee)

Field Shovel ---> Shovel 1

Specials (Previously Grenades)
BKG400 Grenade ---> Big Bang 400
BKGS440 Smoke Grenade ---> Smokie 10
Flashbang ---> Solar Flare 1

Item/Shop


  • Decay mechanic has been changed. The amount of decay after a match is directly connected to the equipped time of the weapon.

  • For example, if a player held main weapon for 60%, melee for 30%, and grenade for 10% of playing time, decay amounts are like so:

    Main - amount of decay x 60%
    Secondary - amount of decay x 0%
    Melee - amount of decay x 30%
    Grenade - amount of decay x 10%

    Each amount of decay is rounded up to the nearest 0.5%.

  • Jet pack and wings are upgradeable like other bags.
  • Luck stat has been removed for gas masks and gas mask bags.
  • Stats for the SWAT water bottle are the same as other water bottles now.
  • Tooltip for upgradable item has upgradable icon in the Shop screen.
  • Upgraded item in the Inventory screen has upgraded icon in the bottom left corner.
  • 'All' category has been added into the Shop and Inventory. 'Premium' and 'Misc' categories have been removed from the Shop and Inventory.
  • Height of item tooltip is adjusted dynamically by contents.


Want to discuss the latest changes to Brick-Force? Check out the Patch 1.23.153 discussion thread to leave your comments and make your voice heard!

posts.h:
Bug Fixes
  • Added various cheat protection functions.

Item/Shop
  • Added Gamescom item "Brick Fawkes" character head into the game with redeemable code.

Bug Fixes
  • Clan applications are now approved in cases where the approving player would have been disconnected before.
  • Damage upgrade is now working for melee weapons (e.g. Upgrade Wrench from 70% damage to 90%, now deals 90%).
  • Correct score and time limit information for Capture the Flag and Build and Destroy mode is now displayed.

Item Shop
  • Weapons can now be repaired using Tokens. The repair cost for Tokens is 20% of the Force Point cost.

Play Mode
  • Force Points awarded after a match have been adjusted.

New Features


  • Defense mode.
  • Daily Mission system.
  • Pick 'N Win.
  • Players can now toggle the option to build during the shooting phase in Build and Destroy.

Bug Fixes


  • Max player setting can no longer be set to 1 in the "Create Room" dialog.
  • Medium upgrade gems now work for a level 20 (Warrant Officer 3) player, as described. Previously would not function until level 21.
  • Big upgrade gems work for a level 35 (Captain 5) player, as described. Previously would not function until level 36.
  • Massive XP reward for death match has been fixed as of server-side patch 1.23.159.6.
  • Voice sound when throwing a Solar Flare now plays.

Play Mode


  • Build gun can be equipped in the shooter phase (if enabled during room creation) with the "Toggle Mode (BND Only)" key.
  • Room master is able to force-start if there is at least one opponent who is ready. This will start a countdown that can be seen by all players in the room. All ready players will start when the countdown reaches 0. If all players are ready, the match will start even though the countdown has not ended. If no opponents are ready, the force-start will be canceled. The room master can cancel this countdown at any time.
  • If the room master kicks a player, the player cannot enter into the room again. The kicked player can only re-enter after the room master leaves.
  • Room master can assign the role to another player.
  • Room list will show a room in gray if the player cannot join.

Build Mode


  • Map registration fee for a map has been reduced by up to 50%.

    Force Points
    Min. 3000
    Max 6000

    Brick Points
    Min. 2000
    Max 4000

    Tokens
    Min. 400
    Max 800

Weapons


  • Improved balancing for Light weapons and lower-end Long weapons.

User Interface


  • Copyright text moved to the bottom of login screen.
  • ⓒ is no longer broken in the Web player.
  • The order of lobby tools has been changed.
    Friend > Clan > Clan Match > Mail > Settings > Pick 'N Win > Daily Mission

Items

New items are now available exclusively from Pick 'N Win.

Weapons: Orange SMG, Orange Assault, Orange Sniper, Orange MG
Clothing: Snow Jacket, Snow Pants, Snow Helmet
Accessories: Scopes, Snow Bag, Snow Magazine R, Snow Magazine L

Misc.


  • New currency added: Coins.
  • Coins are earned from completing Daily Missions and can only be used in Pick 'N' Win.

Bug Fix


  • XP and Force Points distribution

    • ​The issue affecting XP and Force Points distribution which resulted in a minority of players gathering masses of points has now been resolved. The correct number of points will now be distributed.
    • Players who exploited this bug will have the appropriate XP and Force Points removed from their accounts.

Bug Fixes
  • Daily Mission system now counts kills in Defense mode.
  • In Defense mode, the Daily Mission system and Boss Alert overlapped. Now, the Boss Alert window in Defense mode is readable above the Daily Mission text.
  • The drop down menu for selecting language in-game is no longer mirrored.
  • Invalid model for the PC Games Canteen has been fixed.


User Interface
  • Player can now change the language in the setting dialog.
  • Daily Mission system no longer shows the "at least" conditions. (i.e. at least 3 other players must be present to fulfill this mission)
  • Players can manually refresh the Room List to see newly opened rooms.
  • Players no longer selects which channel to play on. When clicking on Play, Build, or Clan from the Start or Lobby screen, the player automatically enters the best channel. New players enter the Beginners channel upon clicking the Play button.
  • Server List button lists all channels by mode (Play/Build/Clan).
  • Beginner button has been changed to Server List button.
  • Player goes back to the Start screen when clicking the Back button in the Lobby.
  • Player can go to channel list by clicking Server List button in the top right of the Lobby.
  • Filter options have been added to the Room List screen.

Play Mode
  • Player receives XP in Defense mode for killing other players.
  • When "Use Build Gun in Destroy Phase" is enabled in a Build and Destroy match, a notice will appear while switching phases informing the player of what key toggles the Build Gun.
  • Force Point distribution has been changed.
  • When a projectile is thrown, HUD will display distance needed to escape blast radius.

Item Shop
  • "Etc" main category has been added into Shop and Equip window.

User Interface
  • Refresh button in the room list has moved to the top left of the screen.
  • Players will go back one screen when they click the Back button at the server list. Depending on where they were prior to the server list, players will go back to the Lobby or start screen.
  • In the Room List, only the selected room constantly refreshes itself. To refresh all rooms in the list, players must manually click the refresh button in the top left corner.

Play Mode
  • Projectile alert displays for grenades and flashbangs. Smoke grenades do not display this alert.
  • Projectile alert now displays how close or far the projectile is to the player, no longer the distance the player needs to escape the field of damage.

Gameplay
  • Players can now jump off ladders freely.
  • When players mute the sound, the tutorial sound will also be muted.
  • Turrets are muted as well, when sound is set to mute

User Interface
  • Item purchase dialog shows armor or buff information for characters, costumes and accessories.
  • UI Layout has been changed for 1024x768 resolutions.
  • UI Scale option is always active in lower resolutions than 1024x768
  • Players can change the UI scale option in the settings dialog.
  • 4:3 fixed ratio for UI scale has been implemented

Pick ‘n’ Win
  • Player can get new rare items in Pick & win

Items
  • Added Zebra and Tiger costumes to the shop
  • Season1 rare items stats were improved

Equipment
  • Clown Mask color has been changed
  • Camouflage texture has been modified for certain items (except Tiger costume)

Bug Fixes
  • Hide players names doesn’t require a restart of the client anymore

http://cdn.infernum.com/WebAssets_2013/CW43_Bricksaga/BFS3Logo.jpg

Game Changes:

Level up rewards – Rewards have been corrected, players should now receive the correct reward when leveling up.

Map Downloads - The level to download maps have been set to level 5, this is to help prevent map download exploiting.

Invert Mouse Wheel – The option to invert your mouse wheel has been added to the “settings” panel.

Sound Effects – Sound effect has been added to jumping, this is heard when a player lands after they have jumped.

Patch Notes 3.13.291.82

General:

  • New Game mode added: “FreeFall”
  • New Weapons added:
    - Shiny Hornet Crossbow of Epicness
    - Moongun 2.0 Prototype
    - Silver Beetle
    - Silver Rattler
    - Snow Hornet
  • Game Score: During battle, the game score tabwill show the list score range, and the character color as orange.
  • Clan Join Alert: Message alert added for whena member accepts a clan invitation to clan master.
  • Build Room: In the build mode, new player joinnotice message is added.
  • Chat Button: Chatting button order is changed(all / clan /team)
  • Battle Room Lobby: If room master don’t startthe game in 15 seconds (more than 6 players are ready), the master will bekicked.
  • Channel Bonus: Channel buff will be shownin the characher window to display the bonus amount for playing Beginner,Medium and Vetran channels.
  • Multi Purchasing: In shop, multi purchasingoption has been added. *TheMulti-Purchase buttons still have display and functionality (known) issueswhich should get resolved this coming week.*
  • Build Mode: If action panel items are used upan alert will be displayed.
  • Channel Button: Channel button show currentchannel you are in.
  • Network Improvements

Settings:

  • Game settings: Game settings have beenimproved to include new settings for whisper function and freefall.
  • Chat Window: The chat window is now useable indifferent panels eg. Shop, Map Manager, Room List. This function can beactivated by clicking the button located lower mid screen.
  • Click Player Name: New features have beenadded to clicking a player’s name in chat or in the namelist. These settings include:
    - /w (whisper user)
    - Invite (this feature will invite a player toyour play room)
    - Join: This feature will allow youto join a users play room.
    - Mail: This will allow you to opena mail window to selected player.
  • ESC Options: Game settings are changeableduring game play.

Bug Fixes:

  • Premium Feature "Resurrect"not working has been fixed.
  • Turret animation bug is fixed.
  • Placed boomslangs will now still work even if the person who placed the boomslang already died.
  • In the tutorial, resolution is changeable.
  • Stuck arrow from Crossbows’ arrow flying animation is removed.
  • Exploit with XP/FP boosters has been addressed.
  • Trap brick bug fixed that damageda player when near a spike trap.
  • Grenade and rocket launcher bugfixed where players did not take damage from different postion.
  • Fixed incorrect item equipeddisplay issue of some items changed in play room lobby.

General


  • Interface Removal: Now you can remove your interface in a match by using the DEL key, to allow for some great videos and screenshots.
  • Vote-Kick system: Players may now vote to remove someone from their play room.
  • New Build Gun: Brick-Gun (Auto): A fully auto brick-gun has been added at last!
  • New Fantasy Weapons added: All new weapons added, Centaurion Beetle Hammer, Fire Dragon Flame Sword, Griffon’s Lantern, Orc’s Club, Warlock’s Wand, and X-Bow now available in the shop.
  • New Fantasy Costumes added: Centaurion Costume, Fire Dragon Costume, Warlock Costume, Orc Costume, and Griffon Costume are now available in the shop.
  • Continuous Play: A reward system has been added to gift you pick-n-win coins based on how long you spend playing.
    o 70mins = 1 coin
    o 140mins = 1 coin
  • Premium Item Innovatory : Lists all premium items for Premium Accounts.
  • Pick-N-Win: Complete over-hall to pick-n-win layout and new items added.
  • Special Brick Count: Special Brick count is now displayed in build mode on the pallet.
  • Player Block: You can now block a player from your build room by using /block playername


Bug Fixes


  • Dragon Staff Bug Fixed.
  • Spawn Shield will disappear after a grenade is used.
  • Jumping over grenade bug has been fixed.
  • Grenade launcher fixed effect for shots fired.
  • Incorrect player head shown in player info when viewing a player fixed.
  • Player KO’d in sniper state will return to normal view.
  • Corrected level up reward text.
  • Level up rewards not issued bug is fixed.
  • When registering a map fails a reason will be displayed.


Bugs


  • Premium-Items got removed from the tasklist after every round.
  • With "removed interface" you it´s impossible to respawn (pressing DEL key again help)

General

  • Mid-game joining is now available for Defense mode
  • You can now use the "tab" key in order to navigate through the mail menu
  • The User Interface has received a cosmetic overhaul
    • Room list was moved to the lobby
    • Selected room information is now shown on the character information position
  • Kick-Vote is back and needs 75% of all players in a match to vote for a kick
    • The new system is not active in the clan room


Bug Fixes

  • The issue where bees could only be killed by melee weapons and grenades has now been fixed

Patch Notes - 3.19.328.102

Greetings soldiers! The latest update for Brick-Force has arrived. Below you can find a complete list of changes contained in today's update.

General Changes


  • Temporarily deactivated the vote kick functionality
  • Resolved an issue where premium items would sometimes vanish from the Action Panel after re-logging into the game
  • The Dragon Staff has had its weapon collision size adjusted with the intention of making it more balanced
  • New item: Lollipop Stick! (coming soon)

Interface and Accessibility


  • Some of the new weapons are now upgradable!
  • In the Game Room list, some of the flag marker have now been removed to make the menu more accessible, especially for new players
  • The oversized text issue that was affecting the Play Room for some languages has now been fixed

General
  • You can now dash by double tapping "forward" (standard: W)
    • Please note: Dash will not stack with Warpies.
  • There have some tweaks been made to the UI
  • Report functionality is now available
  • There is a preview function for bundled Items now
  • Ingame Mail:
    • You will be notified if your mailbox is (close to) full now
    • You can mass delete mails now

Bug Fixes
  • You can’t get multiple rewards after a match has ended.
  • You won’t be kicked from build mode if your client lags
  • Isis Ultra is now upgradable

Bug Fixes
  • Login Rewards have been fixed.
  • Random Invite Function now properly works for Death Match, Defense and Freefall Mode
  • You can now Quick Join a game again after having been kicked from a match.

New Content

New Game Mode: Wanted
  • The new Wanted game mode can now be activated for DM and TDM.
    - Players marked as “Wanted” will be significantly stronger than normal players but a kill will provide more points than usual.
    - The player who achieves the kill will become the Wanted afterwards.

New Gameplay Mechanics
  • Dual Wield: Selected colts can be used in dual wield mode.
    - They can be found in the main hand category.
  • Crouching: Now you can hide behind bricks to dodge bullets (Default Key: Left CTRL)
    - The new function will be explained in the tutorial as well from now on
  • Weapon Drop: Upon setting up a game room you can now select if defeated players drop their weapon for others to pick up (Default Key: G)
    - The amount of bullets is based on how many were still left, when the gun was dropped

New Western Costumes
  • Sheriff
  • Native American
  • Muchacho
  • Bandit

New Western Weapons
  • Justice
  • Pow-Wow
  • Sundance
  • Horseshoe
  • Hellgate
  • Rose
  • Road Sign
  • Cactus Bomb
  • TNT
  • Cavalry
  • Halfmoon
  • Roller
  • Bullock
  • Lone Star

New Western Bricks
  • Straight Mine Rail
  • Bent Mine Rail
  • Dry Grass
  • Lumber
  • Wagon Wheel
  • Spiky Cactus
  • Saloon Door
  • Haystack
  • Mineral Ore
  • Gold Ore
  • TNT Barrel
  • Oak Brick
  • Spruce Brick

General

Selfkill
  • If a player, you have already dealt (the most) damage to, decides to kill himself you will now be rewarded with the kill
Game Lobby
  • You can now move your character to an empty position in the game lobby before a match starts by clicking on it
  • Item Upgrade timer has been significantly reduced

Match
  • There is now a visible mark to indicate your team in the score overview (Default Key: Tab)
  • Spectators will now be marked in the score overview
  • There is now a visible mark for the last 10 seconds of a match

Build Mode
  • The last remaining brick is there to stay and can’t be removed anymore

Bug Fixes

  • Dash will now be deactivated correctly when you try to set/defuse a bomb or use a turret.
  • Fixed a bug preventing maps from being registered
  • Fixed a bug that allowed players to remove bricks while the “Register” option is active
  • Fixed a bug that the game exits in build mode
  • Fixed a bug that prevented the grenade timer to go off correctly
  • Fixed a bug in build mode that allowed players to fly vertically very fast. No more Mr. Rocketman for you
  • Fixed a bug in the map search option

New Content

New Game Mode: Zombie Mode
  • You will now be able to participate in thrilling matches against zombies and try to stop the outbreak. But be careful, they don’t die easily and you might even join their forces if you die. Learn more about the zombie mode here!


General
  • Webplayer is back
  • 5 New Player Ranks
  • New Grass Brick
    • Be careful, this grass will slow you down while running through it
  • Whole new Pick’N’Win Outfit and weapons
  • To stop farming new players for Force Points, the fun channel no longer rewards any Force Points. You will have to compete against real opponents for these now.
  • There will be a Star Level Lock in place for rooms now:
    • Beginner Channel: Up to 3 star weapons
    • Medium Channel: Up to 4 star weapons
    • Veteran / Fun Channel: All weapons allowed
  • There will be no more Pick’N’Win coins awarded upon login. The 200 Force Points Login Reward was left untouched though.
  • The toolbar icons have been improved

Bug Fixes
  • Client does not crash anymore when pressing ESC while you’re in the Shop
  • Fixed a bug that the red outline of a player was not shown after respawning
  • Fixed a bug with clan insignias
  • Fixed a bug in Defusion mode that prevented the time from running out after the host died

Known Issues
  • Player Rank Names for the levels 61 – 65 are mixed up at the moment

General
The Chaotic Times are over.
  • The following servers are available as of today:
    • Beginner Channel: 1 - 15
    • Medium Channel: 5 - 30
    • Veteran Channel: from level 5
    • Beginner Channel: +5% XP
    • Medium Channel: +10% XP
    • Veteran Channel: +15% XP

  • All items are available from level 1
  • FP Boosters and Chargers are back in the shop
  • There are now only large Upgrade Gems
    • Their prices have been lowered
    • Level rewards will be adjusted accordingly with the next patch

  • All weapons can now be rented or purchased
    • This allows you to try before you buy

  • The following weapons are now permanently available for Force Points:
    • Desert Bullpup
    • Cobra 42
    • Cactus Bomb
    • Eagleeye Crossbow
    • Orion
    • Thunder 18k
    • Eagle 12
    • Cirrus 85
    • Spider 36
    • Saurus 42
    • Hurricane 4
Build Mode
  • Rail Bricks added to the game
  • Lore for the rails added

General

  • Fixed a visibility issue with the Pick’N’Win Board. Permanent weapons will now display the correct “permanent” value instead of a number.
  • The “Design a Western Weapon” winner gun made it to Brick-Force. You can find the “Thornblaster” in our shop from today on.

New Content

  • The Escape Mode is now active. You will need to build maps especially for that mode before you can play it.

Bug Fixes

  • Stats on items work properly now (for example 100% XP on the black knight cape)
  • Pick'n'Win Charger exploit fixed

Bug Fixes

  • fixed stuck issue after some Escape mode matches
  • players can now choose to play Escape mode matches without any weapons
  • male & female Hanbok set items can now be upgraded
